notes.title: New Standard Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31303718/cae23aa79d9dce8d958e1a809c8790b7ad6cc254.png[/img]

Featured:
*Added a new Item that allows two Phase Shields or more to be stacked.
*Better Animations for the phase fields.

Main upgrades:
*New Graphics Settings added: You can change the rendering type and center the game in full screen.
*Added a New Background for the Title Screen if the Game is Completed.
*When the Bitacora is fully unlocked, it becomes available in the title menu.
*After the game is completed, that save file's description will show its performance level.

Small upgrades:
*Polishing the effect of taking a Respawn Point.
*Polish to a screen name portrait.
*The teleport effect to the artificial zones is smoother.
*Some little polish to the Final Reward Screen.

Corrections:
*The first instances when loading a map now avoid consuming the phase field's time.

Fixes:
*Better placement for two respawn points in the Main zone of the Stage 11.

Happy Summer Sale 2024!

notes.title: New Global Update
notes.content:
[b]Featured Big Update:[/b]

*Reworked the Paths of the NPCs, especially the ones that send the player towards an Artificial Space:
-For the Stage One: Areas 2, 3, 4 and the Main Zone.
-For the Stage Three: Areas 2, 3, 4.
-For the Stage Four: Areas 2, 3, 4 and the Main Zone.
-For the Stage Five: Areas 2 and the Main Zone.
-For the Stage Six: Areas 2, 3, 4 and the Main Zone.
-For the Stage Seven: Areas 2, 3, 4 and the Main Zone.
-For the Stage Eight: Areas 2, 3, 4.
-For the Stage Ten: Area 2. Adjusted the paths of such new NPCs behaviours in the Main Zone too.
(Their level design has been upgraded too, heavily in the Main Zones of the stages 6 and 7.)


Standard upgrades:
*A General Global Extra Optimization For the Game. For example:
-With low frame rates, the animated environment is paused, it resumes when it gets back to 60fps.
-Cache load for the HUD pictures.
-Extended the hold limit of the memory cache, to 150 pictures.
*A fast removal of secondary HUD after the Omega Token Device is lost and a smoother "Vault lost" visual effect.

Fixes:
*There was an extra dialog box picture, for when recharged the fuel with the exchangers. It is fixed now.

Thank you for your support!

notes.title: Optimization Update
notes.content:
Featured:
*New visual clues for the loading and saving times.
*Polished the Main Menu's reaction times.
*Extra performance optimization for the Hyper Jump space.

Small upgrades:
*The exit portal that takes fuel is faster

Corrections:
*A bit more of delay time for the shiny barrier, at the start of the Stage 26.

Fixes:
*Fixed a double menu trigger softlock, after a collision with the borders of an artificial space.

Thank you for your support!

notes.title: New Standard Update
notes.content:
This version 6.3.7.7 contains:

Featured:
*Two new HUDs indicators for the Fuel and Shields, on the Main Menu of the game.
*Now, if all golden medals of a Stage were collected. In the respective section of the Fractal Exploration System, a golden frame will appear for such stage.

Standard:
*New Type of Green shields that respawn, those can be found on one of the last stages of the game.
*A better visual for a terrain layer in one of the last stages of the game.
*Some optimization for the Arcader 3000.
*The Tachyon Field effect with battlers on the map is now faster and dynamic.
*Added a new animation for the objects that require bronze gears on one of the last stages of the game. It indicates the amount instead of just a text message all the time.

Small upgrades:
*A little polish to an animation skill: the "Destructive Wave" one used by space probes.
*Added the "stored item" animation to the Fuel item, for when the Vault is active.
*The Golden Medal obtained that appears after finishing an area or zone, has now a Golden Gear Icon to represent more clearly its function.
*More pitch variations for when the laser chargers are taken.
*For the biggest map with ice asteroids, there was added a visual clue when a laser charge is collected after being taken.

Corrections:
*Adjusted the lower amount of golden gears that the Portals remove in the artificial spaces, to give more margin in easier difficulties.
*The Vault didn't have its animation when player was on the Bonus Areas, now it has.
*The Ultra and Omega Speed time were consumed too fast during the use of the Arcader 3000, now their time does not consume at all.
*The Ice Asteroids impact sounds had been adjusted to feel smoother.
*Added a transparency to the "You are Here" effect when respawning on the map.
*Polish to the Main Zone of Stage 10:
 -The especial case of the animation trigger when the menu is used, is now way faster.
 -Taking the Restoration Points is faster and they temporarily banish.
*The message of Game Over, indicating that the Golden Gears are gone, is better aligned to the center.
*When the shields or hp items are maxed out, their disappear a little bit faster.
*The impact from puzzle objects that are asteroids (The Ice Asteroids and the ones like brown boulders), does not affect the Items collected since in most of these cases the collision cannot be avoided.
*Added a way to go to the respawn point when entered a closed path, this happens on the main zone of Stage 22.
*On the new effects for the puzzle platforms of the Stage 21, there was an unnecessary spin when solving it correctly. It has been removed to save up time.
*In Fractal Exploration System, there was updated the capsule picture for the Stage 8 to look better.

Fixes:
*There was a softblock of the game that happened to certain groups of battlers in the Area 3 of Stage 25. It has been fixed now.
*Fixed a glitch that prevented the player from moving when launching the Hyper jump from the Main Menu interface.
*Fixed the mistake of the Menu availability on a special bonus map that shouldn't have it.
*Fixed a glitch with the shield item that goes into the inventory didn't add the shield properly.
*The weather effects of stage 10 now go away properly if the Hyper Jump is launched from the map.
*There were two spots in which the tile layer didn't have the latest teleport indicator texture. It is fixed now.
*There was a glitch with the display of some medals indicators in the Fractal Exploration System, it has now been fixed.

Thanks so much for your support!

notes.title: Small update
notes.content:
New version 6.3.1.4

Main:
*Taking a laser charge is way faster now. This makes the spaceship looks cooler when taking multiple at the same time.
*A more dynamic sound when impacting certain type of ice asteroids.

Glitches Solved:
*Fixed a soft-lock of the player that happened in one of the last stages.
*Fixed a sound looping in the tutorial section.
*Fixed a laser charge that didn't reset properly after a stage was ended.

Corrections:
*Corrected a dialogue hint  of an NPC, in order to reflect better the new changes to the game.
*Removed a useless NPC that was lingering on one of the last maps.

notes.title: Patch update
notes.content:
*Adjusted the end trigger of the tachyon phase field.
*The new messages that tell the player about the speed and fields being gone, it triggers just once.
*The sound of the stage indicator disappearing sound is removed if not necessary.
*Increased the speed of the battlers going away with The Tachyon Phase shield.
*Added some fixed block instead of moving ones in the main zone of stage 13.
*The main zone of Stage 20 had some oddly placed tiles spots placement, it is better now.
*Added another respawn point to the same map.
*When getting the max fuel capacity with the exchangers, it gave 12 charges, now it gives 13.

notes.title: New standard update
notes.content:
[b]Featured updates:[/b]

*Taking the Tech-Gear Token takes less time, and it shows the amount collected with small animations.
*The Main Menu is now accessible at the final stage with the fractal exploration system fully unlocked.
*The sound effect when activating the dash is now more dynamic and reactive.
*Added extra sounds to the Arcader mini game when turning right or left.
*A different sprite was assigned to the special blockades for the Stage 24 area 4 onwards. It reflects the objective of being a "wall" better.
*The HUDs are now shown by default on the Hyper Jump space.
*Added a background picture to the Quick Load Menu, and it is smoother too. This happens when losing the game.
*The exchangers that give shields have now a way smoother effect.


[b]More Fixes and Corrections:[/b]

*The name of one of the Attacks was changed, is now cooler.
*Fixed the first restoration point that didn't show the respawn indicator. And added one more obstacle block in the first map.
*Fixed a blocking path for an autostarship due a merchant being in the wrong place. Stage 24 area 2.
*Soften the flash intensity of a collision with the puzzle asteroid of stage 11, from the Area 4 onwards.
*Fixed an obstacle's placement that had the potential of softlocking the player, this happened in one of the last stages of the game.
*An extra adjustment in the case the screen color is not reversed after finishing an stage.
*Fixed one of the audio special effects that happens when getting all the shields.
*Adjusted the ratio for when being expelled from a Bonus Area Challenge after reaching 10 shield capacity.

Have a nice day and Thanks for your support!

notes.title: 1 Year Release!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31303718/1dc3e306a8d51f516b54818335da6ab6b2703946.png[/img]

The game will have a discount of 50% for the rest of the month; it is a good time to get some arcade adventures on the intergalactic space! Get your copy and celebrate the First Year of the release; there has been a lot of updates and without a price increase!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31303718/7910f3719dc32e8fd4e09c0ef9f2f3ce1502ffc9.png[/img]

For September of 2018, there have been new improvements for the game:

1.There has been added a new minigame, when you smash a starship that has an energetic shield you will get teleported to an artificial space, a mini labyrinth with random configurations and just one good exit.

2.There are different backgrounds for different types of evaders.

3.There has been added a message when you get full HP.

4.New battlers have arrived, you can found them in the random encounters, they are the only starships that give you experience points but they can be found in all over the game.

5.The Space Probes that give you exchanges are more balanced now asking for a better range of resources.

6.Some translations for the Spanish version have been updated.

7.The background for the battlers that didn’t reflect the correct area is fixed now.

Update number 16.
The game is now on the version 3.0.0.0! 
Thanks for your support!

notes.title: New August 2018 Update!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31303718/8c1d3661dbc032449599ac6eb9eeab0446a5ef01.png[/img]

•A new animation has been added, each time you finish an area or main zone you will have a better view.

•Now, there is another way to get Tech-gears through a new type of random encounter, this is a space probe that will ask you for various resources and will give you TG, there are different types of rarity, the more special the probe the more resources you can get. This new event applies to most areas and main zones of the game, although its frequency of appearance changes according to the level in which you find yourself.

•Also, now we have "dynamic music", making the game much more entertaining than before. The music will sound different as you go through the levels, or after taking certain items on the map.

•Now, the Backgrounds of the RPG Battles reflects the stage in which each starship are, giving it more visual representation and congruence.

•Finally, a small animation in one of the musical functions of the game, something that happens when you have the maximum of shields and press a key.

The current version is 2.9.0.0
Game Update N.15

notes.title: June Update 2018
notes.content:
[h1]The game has improvements:[/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31303718/423b0bd13413e97351ad044ade7b95a29442f52a.png[/img]

[list]
 	[*]A [u]cinematic introduction[/u] has been added to the game (you can name your starship also); remember that you can know more things by unlocking the pilot's log in the Fractal navigation menu.[/*]
        [*][u]Difficulty levels have been implemented!
        [*][u]Improvements in the secondary menu[/u]: The cursor is more colorful besides that it starts in the first position when activated for the first time.[/*]
 	[*][u]The repair indicator[/u] of the fractal navigation menu has been added at the end of a scenario.[/*]
 	[*][u]It has been balanced the battlers[/u] of the first four scenarios the rare models and the bosses.[/*]
 	[*][u]Now when you lose the game by collisions you can continue playing[/u], but you will have to give 5 gold gears and continue with a red shield, which will imply that lower the final score. If you lose by an RPG battle or by losing fuel then it is completely game over.[/*]

notes.title: May Update 2018
notes.content:
The game has improvements:

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31303718/7a11fec07f1280ec35727e08f3bf0627e27cb14f.png[/img]

+ There has been added 4 Music Tracks to the game. (The DLC_Sountrack has been updated too)
+ There is now a visual difference between evaders and battlers, the first ones will display a blue shield.
+ The Text is instant displayed after taking an item in the map.
+ The color of the time counter changes, becoming red, it means that you will lose the Hyper Speed result.
+ The number of the current Stage is represented in the Main Menu interface.
+ The Background in the Main Menu interface changes according the stage you are in.
+ The noise of the backgrounds of the first five stages has been removed.

The current version is 2.4.5.5
Game Update N.12

notes.title: New Version 2.4.0.0
notes.content:
A new big update for the game has been released:

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31303718/faa902a348bb211f24145f1edc28914afb166f8e.png[/img]

* The game now has a better end game with the Final Result screen (at the end of the game), you will be able to see how good you are, taking into account the number of Hyper Speed and Golden Medals obtained, the maximum fight level of the starship and steps taken. 

As always, the best form to get a higher score is to collect golden gears, with the Final Result Screen you can earn up to 20 more if you get everything on five stars.

* There has been added, a new visual on screen, a time counter, it will display how much time you are spending on each Area or Zone. It is a nice way to keep track of your speed results. 

* There has been added more cursor animations to the Main Menu.

* This includes a total of 42 corrections in the game, and more than 65 miscellaneous graphical resources, mostly added by the final result screen.

There has been added upgrades focused mostly on animations:

When you obtain full power points from an exchanger a message is displayed.
The battles ending has now a slow animation of desfragmentation.

The animated environment is activated from the start, you can disable it anytime in the menu, visual options.
The first level area of the game, that works as a tutorial, gives you fuel items and unlimited shields when you are at critical levels. You still have to search and take them.

The current version is 2.1.9.7
